digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool search configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before first use, creating friction compared to always-loaded tools like Bash.
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is a global all-or-nothing lever with no per-tool or per-server granularity; there is no way to selectively keep only Serena's navigation tools resident.

Loading all MCP tool schemas upfront costs 25k+ tokens for Serena alone and 64k+ tokens on systems with multiple connected servers, but this is acceptable given the defect prevention benefit and single-key revert cost.

A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false, plus a .gitignore negation allowing only that file, eliminates the discovery-step friction while keeping operator-local settings untracked.
